headline: Public hearing on proposed PY2024 Community Development Block Grant applications for public services, facilities, and affordable housing.
summary: Discussion and possible vote on proposed PY2024 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) applications. Review of whether the proposed activities comply with the City's Comprehensive Plan and Development Ordinances and Regulations.
items: Discussion and possible vote on proposed PY2024 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) applications
Presentation of proposed public services activities
Presentation of proposed public facilities and infrastructure activities
Presentation of proposed affordable housing activities
Review of proposed activities to determine compliance with the City's Comprehensive Plan and Development Ordinances and Regulations
Discussion and possible vote on certifying compliance with the City's Comprehensive Plan and Development Ordinances and Regulations
location: The Bessette Building (DPW), 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
plain_text:
CITY OF CENTRAL FALLS 
                 COMBINED PLANNING AND ZONING BOARD 
 
 
Page 1 of 1 
SPECIAL MEETING 
(PUBLIC HEARING) 
Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
The Bessette Building (DPW) – 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863 
 
AGENDA 
I. Call to Order 
II. Roll Call 
III. Pledge of Allegiance 
IV. Approval of Minutes 
       A. Regular Meeting Minutes of August 26, 2026  
      B. Regular Meeting Minutes of September 23, 2026 
V. New Business 
A. Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Planning Board, discussion and possible vote on 
     proposed PY2024 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Applications: 
     i. Presentation of proposed activities: 
          1. Proposed Public Services Activities 
          2. Proposed Public Facilities/Infrastructure Activities 
          3. Proposed Affordable Housing Activities 
    ii. Review of proposed activities to determine compliance with City’s Comprehensive Plan and 
               Development Ordinances and Regulations 
   iii. Discussion and possible vote with respect to certification of compliance with City’s 
               Comprehensive Plan and Development Ordinances and Regulations 
VI. Adjournment 
Pursuant to Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-4, the Board reserves the right to convene in executive session on any of the aforementioned items 
for one or more of the purposes listed in Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-5(1)-(10).
